notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, causing any number of players to mill that many cards.
